task_completion.description: Set the Homepage to the local library portal file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In Firefox Settings (Home section), the 'Homepage and new windows' field shows 'Custom URLs' with 'file:///workspace/assets/library_portal.html' entered.

task_completion.description: Configure the Bookmarks Toolbar to 'Always Show'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Bookmarks Toolbar is visible below the address bar in the browser UI, or the 'Bookmarks Toolbar' menu option shows 'Always Show' selected.

task_completion.description: Add Project Gutenberg bookmark to the Bookmarks Toolbar.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A bookmark titled 'Project Gutenberg' is visible on the Bookmarks Toolbar. The URL property for this bookmark must be 'https://www.gutenberg.org/'.

task_completion.description: Add Directory of Open Access Journals bookmark to the Bookmarks Toolbar.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A bookmark titled 'Directory of Open Access Journals' is visible on the Bookmarks Toolbar. The URL property for this bookmark must be 'https://doaj.org/'.

task_completion.description: Enable 'Clear history when Firefox closes' in Privacy & Security settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In Firefox Settings (Privacy & Security), under the History section, 'Firefox will' is set to 'Use custom settings for history' and the checkbox 'Clear history when Firefox closes' is checked.

task_completion.description: Gracefully close the Firefox browser window.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final screenshots show the agent clicking the 'X' close button or using the menu to Quit/Exit, followed by the desktop environment without the Firefox window visible.

integrity.description: The agent used the Firefox GUI to change settings rather than editing profile files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Firefox Settings menu and dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply type the URLs into the address bar to fake a bookmark presence.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen opening the 'Add Bookmark' or 'Library' dialogs and specifically placing them on the 'Bookmarks Toolbar'.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the actual Firefox Preferences/Settings pages.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the transition from the hamburger menu to the Settings tab and specific sub-sections (Home, Privacy).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The local homepage file is located at file:///workspace/assets/library_portal.html. The two required bookmarks are 'Project Gutenberg' (https://www.gutenberg.org/) and 'Directory of Open Access Journals' (https://doaj.org/). To enable 'Clear history when Firefox closes', the history mode must usually be set to 'Use custom settings for history' first.
